text: The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to designate the westerly northbound lane on Royal York Road at the private driveway access to Humbertown Shopping Centre, north of Strath Humber Court, for left-turns only. This proposed lane designation, in conjunction with a lane marking modification upstream, will address the issue of significant northbound vehicle queueing on Royal York Road extending back from the driveway access at Humbertown Shopping Centre southerly to the Dundas Street West overpass. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates transit service on Royal York Road, City Council approval of this report is required.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate the westerly northbound lane on Royal York Road, from a point 35 metres north of Strath Humber Court to a point 30.5 metres south, for northbound left turns only.
